title: Rosemary Beach: Joy of Home in WaterSound – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Rosemary Beach: Joy of Home in WaterSound. Joy of Home is located in the gated private community of WaterSound Beach, Bridges neighborhood and offers enviable views of Camp Creek Lake and the Gulf of Mexico beyond.
description_expanded:
Property includes private beach access at WaterSound Beach with one set of beach chairs included (March 1 - October 31). Additional beach chairs available through La Dolce Vita. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included. Guests will also have complimentary access to WaterSound Fitness, Dunsider Pool in WaterSound Beach and Bridges Pool on Tide Bridge Way. Property not located in Rosemary Beach community and will not have access to the Rosemary Beach community beaches or pools.

Joy of Home is located in the gated private community of WaterSound Beach, Bridges neighborhood and offers enviable views of Camp Creek Lake and the Gulf of Mexico beyond. This newly renovated residence exhibits the work of renowned Interior Designer Ashley Gilbreath. Ideally situated steps from both the community dock and private beach walkover.

Returning from nature, the expertly landscaped scrub oaks provide shade and privacy to the first floor, screened back porch - a truly welcome respite regardless of season. The outdoor amenities continue in the private courtyard. The newly constructed pool is one of the largest in the community, featuring a tanning ledge and long-lasting IPE planking deck surround. The covered barbecue area includes a flat screen television and Big Green Egg smoker atop black soapstone counters. A cypress front foyer leads to a first-floor seating area flanked by yacht-inspired bunks of navy, brass, and creams. It's the perfect pool house feel with NanaWall access to the courtyard beyond. This flexible space can act as a standalone room or share a jack-n-jill bathroom with one of three guest suites on the same floor.

Ascending to the second floor, the vista of Camp Creek Lake and the Gulf come into clear focus. Soaring Cypress cathedral ceilings are anchored by the dining room fireplace. The residence's fully custom kitchen design features a one-of-a-kind brass strapping hood vent adorning the six-burner range, a reclaimed antique kitchen island for dish storage, and a stunning custom waterfall peninsula for casual dining. Through the living room's NanaWall, the partially covered balcony beckons for outdoor dining and relaxation. Start and end your day by delighting in the extraordinary sunrises and sunsets from the second-floor primary suite with a cathedral ceiling and custom designed bathroom.

Continuing higher, a third-floor loft study overlooks the living and dining rooms below. Climbing the spiral staircase from the study, 11 South Lake Bridge is crowned by a cupola and observation deck offering lighthouse 360-degree views.

**REQUIRES A 7-NIGHT MINIMUM SATURDAY TO SATURDAY DURING SPRING BREAK & SUMMER

**Pool may be heated October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee
